SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalCount, COUNT(execute_time) AS finishedCount, SUM(IF(execute_time is null, 1, 0)) AS waitExecuteCount, SUM(promote_num) AS totalPromoteNum, SUM(intent_num) AS totalIntentNum, ROUND(SUM(intent_num) / SUM(promote_num), 2) AS intentRate FROM promote_mgmt WHERE deleted = 0
AND YEAR(create_time) = #{year}
